deterministicBeforeFix.scope: Same final new regression source against unmodified base product. No sleep, provider assertion, relaxed count, raised timeout or retry until green.

changeReview.product: Reuse the fresh latest snapshot and always read the current root wake under the dialog mutex before core. For backend source only, no effective prompt, no durable work and no current root wake ends this attempt. Existing stale-queued continuation handling is retained. Present concrete continuation handlers retain their business claims; direct drives and explicit prompts are not newly gated.
changeReview.newRegression: Event-gate the actual canDrive result, let another real drive consume the same queued prompt, release the backend. Require exactly one provider request/gen and preserve the given input. Queue genuinely new work and require exactly one additional request/gen, both given response payloads, and no remaining pending work. Provider fixture always completes; assertions are outside its retry boundary.
changeReview.existingBlockerRegression: Keep real active-run deferred wake, actual blocker-cleared event, single delivered tellask result, cleared active dispatches and final given data. Capture provider contexts/counters without throwing assertions in callbacks. After real backend termination assert exactly root2/side1 and one correctly identified completed result. The >=2 wait merely synchronizes; exact counts remain required after shutdown.
changeReview.literalAssertionReview: Text equality and includes compare entire supplied opaque inputs/results, machine enums/IDs and persisted data; no generated guidance/log wording is an oracle. No new semantic generation is claimed.
changeReview.limits: The deterministic case controls a known awaited preflight boundary in-process. It is not a multiprocess stress test, live-provider check or proof against every possible concurrent change. Standard60s per-case limit unchanged.
